title: BC Stash
description: Build Control stash file: a flow -> phase -> ordered steps tree recorded during a build/check/deploy run.
$comment: Flow, phase and step names are case-insensitive identifiers (must start with a letter). Case is deliberately NOT constrained: the uppercase summary flow 'FLOW' coexists with lowercase flows like 'build' and 'check', and SlackStash must accept any real stash.

flow.description: Map of flow name -> phases. A flow groups related work (e.g. the 'FLOW' summary, 'build', 'check').

^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$.description: A flow: map of phase name -> steps. Phase names are identifiers (e.g. compile, tagging, upload).
A phase: the ordered steps recorded in this phase (e.g. start, init, end).

items.description: One recorded step: what happened, at what level, when.

step.description: Step identifier (e.g., init, compile, test, end)

level.description: Logged level of this message INF(2)SUC(3)WRN(4)ERR(5)
